title: Correct angle θ
description: Essential: Student's final answer for part (1) must be θ = 30°.

title: Correct friction coefficient μ
description: Essential: Student's final answer for part (2) must be μ = √3 / 5.

title: Force balance on ball
description: Important: Student must apply Newton's first law to the ball, resolving tension and applied force into horizontal and vertical components.

title: System force balance
description: Important: Student must correctly analyze the combined block-ball system to find the normal force and relate friction to the applied horizontal force.

title: Friction law application
description: Important: Student must correctly apply the kinetic friction formula, F_f = μ F_N, to the system.

title: Simultaneous equation solving
description: Optional: Student demonstrates clear algebraic manipulation to solve for θ and T from the ball's equilibrium equations.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student's work shows awareness that the final coefficient μ is dimensionless.

title: Sign error in vertical forces
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly summing vertical forces on the ball (e.g., wrong sign for F sin30° or mg).

title: Incorrect normal force
description: Pitfall: Calculating normal force on the system without including the vertical component of the applied force F.
